content.text: Based on the Next.js App Router structure I can see, the best way to log every request is to create a middleware file. Let me create the middleware:

I've added request logging to your Next.js app by creating a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts:1`.

The middleware will log every request to the console with:
- Timestamp in ISO format
- HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
- Full URL
- User-Agent header
- IP address (from x-forwarded-for or x-real-ip headers)

The matcher configuration excludes Next.js internal routes (_next/static, _next/image) and favicon.ico to reduce noise, but logs all actual page requests and API routes.

When you run `npm run dev` or `npm run start`, you'll see logs like this in your console:
```
[2026-02-16T12:34:56.789Z] GET http://localhost:3000/
  User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0...
  IP: 127.0.0.1
```
